character.name: change to white rabb
character.prompt:
Cute chibi anthropomorphic black rabbit adventurer for a 2D side-scrolling action RPG.

The character has the same overall appeal and proportions as a cute fantasy anime rabbit mascot: a large round head, compact chubby body, very long floppy rabbit ears, small hands and feet, and an energetic charming personality.

Black rabbit fur with subtle dark charcoal highlights so the body shape remains clearly readable.

Large bright expressive eyes with a subtle warm amber-red glow.

Wearing an elegant all-black fantasy adventurer outfit:
a small black top hat, fitted black long coat with coat tails, black vest, black gloves, dark boots, black bow tie, and subtle antique-gold trim and accessories.

The outfit should feel like a mysterious fantasy magician / rogue / adventurer, stylish and cute rather than evil or scary.

Keep the design simple enough for consistent sprite animation.
Clear separation between arms, legs, ears, torso and clothing.
Long ears must remain highly recognizable during movement.

No weapon equipped.
Neutral ready stance.
Full body visible.

SIDE VIEW, facing right.
Designed specifically for a 2D side-scrolling action RPG.
Clean high-quality pixel art.
Crisp readable silhouette.
Consistent pixel scale.
Transparent background.
No ground.
No cast shadow.
No environment.
No text.
Single character only.

rows.animation: The character initiates a sudden, high-velocity horizontal dash, body leaning forward with intense momentum as the legs drive off the ground in a blur of rapid motion. The long ears whip backward, trailing behind the figure to emphasize the swift displacement through the frame. The coat tails flare sharply, reacting to the aerodynamic drag of the sudden sprint while the boots remain firmly grounded in their rhythmic, pixelated stride. Every frame maintains precise, consistent positioning to convey powerful kinetic energy. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick outlines, flat colors, and the strict original perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.
